decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate is the flagship of the firm's sustainability direction and carries strategic aspiration value, so the large firm's slack lets it be carried despite its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021.
The multi-model foldable large container line is central to the returnable-packaging core, and there is no clear signal of a shortfall against aspiration that would trigger problemistic search.
Stackable crates are standard products with broad demand in food and retail, so dropping the line is unlikely even though it is less visible on the website.
The spill-retention pallet serves a narrow industrial niche and its fading website presence hints at weaker results, but slack and the multi-model commitment favour keeping it a while longer.
The single-model niche pallet is the most likely to fall below aspiration and release resources, yet the evidence is not strong enough to justify withdrawal yet.
